answer_1.quote: In the abstractive summarization domain...we have introduced a novel poem summarization dataset named 'Poemsum'...We evaluated the performance of some of the standard summarization models like T5, BART, Pegasus, and mT5 on PoemSum...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the model-generated summaries against the gold reference summaries, we have used the Rouge-1 (R1), Rouge-2 (R2), Rouge-L (RL), and BertScore (BS) metrics.
